full_judgment: 2. The opposite party No. 1 filed Title Suit No. 22 of 1992 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, Moulavi Bazar for declaration of his title in the suit land and recovery of khas possession alleging, inter alia, the suit property Rangi Chara Tea Garden originally belonged to Ext-Jaminder of Protimpasha Nababjada Ali Askar Akha. Record of right was prepared in his name. He died leaving behind only son Ali Laor Khan as his heir who appointed one Imtiaz Ali as his attorney to maintain the garden. The defendant No. 1 was Head Clerk of the said tea garden and used to live in a staff quarter of the tea garden. He was released from service in 1985 and was directed to vacate the staff quarter but claiming title of said Tea Garden he denied to vacate the quarter. Hence the plaintiff filed the instant suit for declaration of title and for possession. Defendant Nos. 1 and 2 appeared in the suit and filed written statement. The suit was decreed on 19-9-2000 on contest against defendant No. 2 and ex parte against the defendant No. 1 on 5-11-2000. The defendant No. 1 filed an application under Order IX, rule 13 of the Code for setting aside the said ex parte decree which was registered as Miscellaneous Case No. 17 of 2000. In the meantime, the said decree was put in execution in Title Execution Case No. 1 of 2001. Then the defendant-petitioner filed an application for staying the further proceeding of said Execution Case. The learned Subordinate Judge by the impugned order dated 8-7-2001 rejected the said application for stay. Against which the defendant moved revisional application before this Court and obtained Rule and ad-interim order of stay of further proceeding of said Execution Case.
